hindsight.reason: Windows/self-hosted is supported, but full memory requires an LLM provider plus embedded/external PostgreSQL. Verified absent on this host: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp server/CLI. Adding provider/daemon/DB complexity is not justified before current baseline is measured.

supermemory.reason: Self-hosted path requires an LLM provider; release/docs platform guidance is inconsistent for Windows, self-hosted lite has a 10000-document license cap, and current v0.0.8 has open provider-detection issues.

authorityConclusion: vfmem remains the sole canonical durable memory; all retrieval outputs remain context requiring canonical verification.
